incident_updates.body:
🟢 This incident has been resolved.

All systems are now operating normally. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused and thank you for your patience.

✅ A fix has been implemented for the issue affecting API Platform, Brand Studio, and Stable Audio suite of products, and we are currently monitoring the results to ensure stability.

We’ll continue to keep a close eye and provide a final update once we confirm everything is fully operational.

⚠️ We have identified the cause of the issue affecting the outages in our API Platform, Brand Studio, and Stable Audio suite of products.

We are working on a fix and will provide an update shortly.

🚧 We are currently investigating reports of elevated 500s affecting our generation API endpoints. Our engineering team is actively working to identify the root cause.

We will provide another update as soon as we have more information. Thank you for your patience.

The Cloudflare outage issue has been resolved. All our services and APIs are operating normally. 

We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused and thank you for your patience.

Our rest APIs had some outage starting 3:25am PT on 11/18. They got fully recovered around 5:05am PT on 11/18. After doing some investigation, the public cloudflare network outage is root cause of this.
All the services have been fully recovered now.
